description: Header file defining the TargetPublicPair class and TargetPublicPairListBuilder for managing dependency lists of targets with public/private flags in build system.

classes.name: TargetPublicPair
classes.description: Encodes a pair of a target pointer and a boolean indicating if it is public, with utility structs for hashing and comparison.

classes.name: TargetPublicPairListBuilder
classes.description: Builds a unique, ordered list of TargetPublicPair instances, supporting appending direct and inherited dependencies.

methods.name: TargetPublicPair
methods.description: Default constructor and parameterized constructors for creating target-public pairs.

methods.name: set_target
methods.description: Sets the target pointer in the pair.

methods.name: set_is_public
methods.description: Sets the public flag in the pair.

methods.name: Append
methods.description: Adds a target-public pair to the list, updating the public flag if the target already exists.

methods.name: AppendInherited
methods.description: Appends pairs from another container, adjusting the public flag based on inheritance.

methods.name: Build
methods.description: Returns the final list of TargetPublicPair instances.
